title: Builder BLD-001: Token map to the 45 contract names

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-001.

detail: B0 Align, pass BLD-001 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-001). Token map to the 45 contract names. Scope: design system + lib/theme. Build: Generate one map from Frequency tokens (Commons, Commons night, Stage) to the contract groups: ground, ink, accent, line, status, band, shape, depth, type, rhythm, motion. Retire --th-* in element-library.md and theme-pack.json; point them at contract names. Done when: Pin test: every contract name resolves on Commons, Commons night and Stage; Computed values equal today's on the 31 design pages. Gates: check:tokens, check:theme-conformance, Design system adherence check, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: nothing. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

verify.evidence: Filed from the builder spec. The pass writes scripts/probes/builder/BLD-001.mjs, proves it fails before the change and passes after, and switches this row to kind cmd in the same PR.
